title: Incomplete-market CAPM equilibria in continuous time
abstract: arXiv:2408.03134v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We study continuous-time CAPM equilibria with general mean-variance preferences of the form $U(\mu,\sigma)$, where $U$ is strictly quasiconcave, increasing in the mean $\mu$ and decreasing in the volatility $\sigma$ of terminal wealth. Our framework accommodates both financial and productive assets with nontradeable endowments. We allow for equilibria driven by general semimartingales in the case of linear mean-variance preferences and by continuous semimartingales in the case of general mean-variance preferences. The key insight is a connection between mean-variance efficiency and quadratic utility maximisation. We first characterise quadratic equilibria through an explicit family of equilibrium price processes indexed by the aggregate risk tolerance. translated_title: 连续时间下不完备市场的CAPM均衡
translated_abstract: 我们研究了具有一般均值-方差偏好形式 $U(\mu,\sigma)$ 的连续时间CAPM均衡，其中 $U$ 是严格拟凹的，对终端财富的均值 $\mu$ 递增，对其波动率 $\sigma$ 递减。我们的框架同时容纳了金融资产与生产性资产以及不可交易的禀赋。在均值-方差偏好为线性的情形下，我们允许均衡由一般半鞅驱动；在一般均值-方差偏好的情形下，允许均衡由连续半鞅驱动。其关键洞察在于均值-方差有效性与二次效用最大化之间的联系。我们首先通过一个以总风险容忍度为指标的显式均衡价格过程族来刻画二次均衡。随后我们证明，每个代理人的最优均值-方差策略都对应于一个具有内生确定风险容忍度的二次最优解。这一对应关系降低了...
tldr: 该论文通过建立均值-方差有效性与二次效用最大化之间的联系，刻画了连续时间不完备市场中具有一般均值-方差偏好的CAPM均衡，证明每个代理人的最优策略对应于一个风险容忍度内生确定的二次最优解。
en_tdlr: This paper characterizes continuous-time CAPM equilibria in incomplete markets with general mean-variance preferences by establishing a connection between mean-variance efficiency and quadratic utility maximization, showing that each agent's optimal mean-variance strategy corresponds to a quadratic optimum with an endogenously determined risk tolerance.
